caption: The rules that the check enforces

rows.rule: A sentence has at most 25 words.
rows.why: A long sentence is hard to follow in a second language.

rows.rule: A button has at most 3 words.
rows.why: A reader must see at once what a button does.

rows.rule: A heading does not end with a full stop.
rows.why: A heading is a name, not a sentence.

rows.rule: A percent sign follows its number without a space.
rows.why: One way of writing a figure in all pages.
